build.buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput --settings=admin_asterisco7.settings_production

deploy.startCommand: python manage.py migrate --settings=admin_asterisco7.settings_production --run-syncdb && python manage.py ensure_superuser --settings=admin_asterisco7.settings_production && python manage.py setup_taquilla_inicial --settings=admin_asterisco7.settings_production || true && gunicorn admin_asterisco7.wsgi --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --log-file - --workers 2 --timeout 120 --env DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=admin_asterisco7.settings_production
